summary: Deploy pdsdl4jm7q reconciled an empty chess_puzzles table but never initialized its reference catalog. Production returned zero rows in the 800–1199, 1200–1599 and 1600–1999 bands, and the critical journey timed out on the empty-feed screen. Initialize a never-populated catalog with the validated committed load file after migration and before shipping; preserve existing rows and tombstones and notify subscribed devices.
